#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        int length = std::stoi(line);
        std::string text_line;
        if (!std::getline(std::cin, text_line)) break;
        const char* text = text_line.c_str();

        int maxWordSize = 0;
        int totalWords = 0;
        int currentSize = 0;
        int position = 0;

        while (position < length) {
            char ch = text[position];

            if (ch != '_' && ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                currentSize++;
            } else if (ch == '_') {
                maxWordSize = std::max(maxWordSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            } else if (ch == '(') {
                maxWordSize = std::max(maxWordSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
                position++;
                while (position < length && text[position] != ')' && text[position] != '_') {
                    ch = text[position];
                    if (ch != '_' && ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                        currentSize++;
                    } else if (ch == '_') {
                        if (currentSize != 0) {
                            totalWords++;
                            currentSize = 0;
                        }
                    } else if (ch == ')') {
                        if (currentSize != 0) {
                            totalWords++;
                            currentSize = 0;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    position++;
                }
            }
            position++;
        }
        maxWordSize = std::max(maxWordSize, currentSize);
        std::cout << maxWordSize << " " << totalWords << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
